Gazette of Pakistan
EXTRAORDINARY
PUBLISHED BY AUTHORITY
ISLAMABAD, MONDAY, JANUARY 8, 2024
PART I
The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on
the 5th January, 2024 is hereby published for general information:—
THE NATIONAL LIBRARY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2024
An Act further to amend the National Library Act, 1993
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the National Library Act, 1993;
It is hereby enacted as follows:—
1. Short title and commencement.—(1) This Act may be called the National Library (Amendment) Act, 2024.
